name: The Climb
design_intent:
TRIALS course 5 of 5 (v3_content_plan PART B; the capstone). MOVEMENT LESSON: VERTICAL MASTERY ASCENT -- climb a zigzag of tiny pads ~2660px UP a shaft, every step a committed DIAGONAL BOOST up-and-across, landing precisely on a small pad before the next. Hardest course: it stacks course_03's precision landings onto a sustained vertical climb that is too tall to reach in one flight.

DERIVED vs CURRENT Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270px (a bounce off any pad here gains ONLY 270px of height), air_drift_max 340px/s, max spring drift ~527px, normal_boost_max 760px/s, super_boost_impulse_full 2800 => straight-up super rise = 2800^2/(2*1600) = 2450px.

LAYOUT: a start pad at the bottom + six tiny trampoline pads (w120) zigzagging between two columns (pad centers x660 <-> x1220, horizontal offset 560px) each ~380px HIGHER than the last + a wide goal pad at the top. Start y2400, goal y-260 => total climb 2660px.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (flight-required proof, GAME_ESSENCE Rule A -- vertical is DOUBLY gated):
- EVERY step rises 380px, but a trampoline bounce only gains 270px of height (apex 270 < 380). You physically cannot bounce UP to the next pad -- you top out 110px BELOW it, still moving. VERTICAL RISE ALONE forbids a bounce ascent. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED each step. Verb: FLY. (Rule A, vertical gate.)
- Each step is ALSO offset 560px horizontally (> 527 max spring drift), so even ignoring height a bounce cannot cover the lateral gap. Doubly flight-required. Verb: FLY (diagonal boost) + precision landing on the 120px pad.
- TOTAL HEIGHT 2660px > 2450px (a full straight-up super's rise), so you CANNOT super from the bottom to the top -- the ascent MUST be taken in staged boosted hops, landing and re-launching. The verticality is the whole challenge, not scenery. Verb: FLY (sustained, staged).
- RECOVER: a missed landing drops you back down the shaft toward the bottom void; a fuelled flier can boost back onto a lower pad (recovery gamble), a starved one rings out at the bottom. Verb: FLY. (Rule D.)

KILL: display void at the shaft floor; a fall rings out below the bottom blast line -> respawn at start_gate + 2.0s. Explicit bounds: bottom 3200 leaves ~670px recovery sky under the start pad; top -2950 clears a straight-up super from the top pad (y-260 - 2450 = -2710 > -2950), so no accidental top ring-out; sides give the narrow shaft runway.

MEDAL TIMES (ROUGH, drive-checked): a clean staged climb of 7 boosted hops (~1.4-1.8s each incl. a precise landing + re-launch) => ~13-17s skilled. gold 14.0 / silver 21.0 / bronze 32.0 (looser -- a mistimed hop drops you far down the shaft).
